deviations.B8.3: calibration sigmoid by team decision B-G-05 (the 8.3 rule result is raw); threshold computed on sigmoid probabilities

B8.1.done: 4 finalists refitted on the five s05 folds: dummy (s06 reference) 0.1380 ± 0.0198; linear/logistic (s06 reference) 0.2616 ± 0.0349; single tree (s06 reference) 0.2394 ± 0.0354; forest (s07 carried (plain s06)) 0.2739 ± 0.0305 (validation ap, mean ± SE).
B8.1.inputs: s06 metrics and learning curves; s07 counts.json (carried model per family) and grid_results.csv; s05 folds.
B8.1.label: observation

B8.2.done: One-SE recommendation: linear/logistic (best mean: forest). Ladder basic to complex: linear/logistic kept over dummy (paired gain +0.1236, better in 5 of 5 folds); single tree not kept over linear/logistic (paired gain -0.0222, better in 0 of 5 folds); forest not kept over linear/logistic (paired gain +0.0123, better in 4 of 5 folds); ladder result linear/logistic. Grid edge of the recommendation: plain s06 model, not a grid configuration.
B8.2.reasoning: The recommendation follows the pre-registered rule; the team confirms or overrides it at the gate (G-39), and an override is logged as a protocol deviation (G-44). Validation scores are selection scores, not generalisation estimates (G-10).
B8.2.conclusion: The team confirmed the recommendation at the combined review of s06-s08 (human_decisions.yaml s08, 2026-10-24).
B8.2.label: observation

B8.3.done: Raw vs sigmoid (CalibratedClassifierCV, time-ordered inner splits) on the recommended model, per fold: mean Brier raw 0.11414 vs sigmoid 0.11461; mean AP raw 0.2616 vs sigmoid 0.2482 (one fold SE 0.0349). Kept: raw probabilities.
B8.3.label: observation

B8.4.done: Threshold candidates on the out-of-fold probabilities of the raw recommended model (50,215 validation rows, 345 days): 0.50 (t=0.5000): 1.0 alerts/day, precision 0.560, recall 0.028, cost 34,178; 1/6 (cost cutoff) (t=0.1667): 19.2 alerts/day, precision 0.294, recall 0.278, cost 29,936; empirical minimum of 5*FN + FP (t=0.1306): 34.0 alerts/day, precision 0.252, recall 0.422, cost 28,977; no alerts: cost 35,000.
B8.4.reasoning: Under the 5:1 cost an alert pays off while the extra false alarms per extra detractor caught stay at or below 5 (Elkan 2001). The threshold is a business choice: the team picks it at the hard stop, with an optional daily alert cap (G-39, G-56).
B8.4.label: observation

B8.5.done: Frozen recipe for B (clf.sel.log.logistic): calibration sigmoid, threshold 0.1667 on the sigmoid-calibrated probability (daily cap 25; out-of-fold 17.0 alerts/day, precision 0.298, recall 0.250); sha256 da056ab74eff09577b2d61746ed5de039beda98dd62e0f0c060fe6b484f94c6d. Written before any test row is read; decisions in human_decisions_B.yaml b08.
B8.5.label: observation

B8.M.done: Population: A-eligible classification development orders in the seven states with a distance, after the warm-up (61,827 orders, 8,884 detractors). B8.A.done: Adoption comparison (G-79) on AP: A's frozen model (clf.sel.log.logistic) refitted per fold on A's training rows vs B's recommended model (clf.sel.log.logistic), both on B's validation rows.
